name: ZSO_PRESENTATION_SESSIONS
description: This table represents a session during which one or more Lighbox Documents or one or more Content Sets are presented.  The session may optionally take place for an appointment, and may optionally take place for an account.  In some cases, the presentation may be ad hoc, which may be related to neither an account nor an appointment, but will be identified only by a date and time.

columns.name: PRESENTATION_SESSION_ID
columns.description: ID column: the uniquely identifying surrogate key value.

columns.name: SESSION_DATE
columns.description: The date and time that the Presentation Session took place.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Appointment for which the Presentation Session has been generated, if applicable.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Account for which the Presentation Session has been generated, if applicable.

columns.name: SESSION_OWNER_ID
columns.description: The session owner will be default from the Activity Owner for actvity-based presentation sessions, and from the current logged in user for ad-hoc presentation sessions.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NO
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
